{{Quote|My name is ''Silam Dunerz'', I'm a ''Supply Master'' for the ''501st Legion'' and I wish to ''defect'' to the ''Rebel Alliance''.|[[Silam Dunerz]]|<ref name="LT" />}}
'''Supply Master''' was a position within various military organizations such as the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] and the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hark'r]] served as the Supply Master for the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]].<ref name="CP" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]] served as a Supply Master for the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="LT" />
